<LawCallout code="ra9266" section="UAP Doc 301, SPP Doc 201-209" title="Bid Document Components">
Essential bid documents: (1) Advertisement/Invitation to Bid; (2) Instructions to Bidders; (3) Proposed Agreement; (4) General Conditions (UAP Doc 301); (5) Special Provisions; (6) Drawings; (7) Specifications; (8) Schedules. The Instructions to Bidders establish binding rules — they specify bid format, deadlines, bond requirements, evaluation criteria, and the consequences of non-compliance.
</LawCallout>

blocks.raw:
<Warn>
  **Exam Trap:** The LEA frequently tests the interpretation hierarchy. The critical rule: **figured dimensions supersede scaled dimensions.** If a written dimension on a drawing says 3.0m but scaling the drawing gives 3.2m, the written dimension controls. Contractors cannot scale drawings without architect authorization.
</Warn>

blocks.raw:
<ProcessFlow>
  **Addendum Issuance Process:**
  Step 1: Architect identifies error, ambiguity, or missing information
  Step 2: Prepare written Addendum — sequentially numbered (No. 1, No. 2, etc.)
  Step 3: Reference specific sections, pages, or drawings affected
  Step 4: State whether it modifies, deletes, or adds information
  Step 5: Distribute to ALL bidders who received original bid documents
  Step 6: If < 48 hours to deadline, extend bid deadline proportionally
  Step 7: Track all Addenda issued and confirm all bidders received them
</ProcessFlow>

blocks.raw:
<ExamTip>
  **LEA Priority — Addenda Rules:**
  1. Addenda must go to ALL bidders (equal information)
  2. Issued < 48 hours before deadline → extend deadline
  3. Addenda are sequentially numbered
  4. Addenda become part of the Contract Documents
  5. Oral clarifications are NOT binding — must be confirmed in writing as an Addendum
</ExamTip>
